title: Mario Draghi, the 'sphinx' still shaping the EU's agenda
subhead: At 79, the former president of the European Central Bank, who no longer holds any official office, remains at the heart of European Union politics. subhead: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (1/7). Mao Zedong, who died on September 9, 1976, founded the People's Republic of China and still casts a shadow over the country's political life. The Chinese Communist Party, whose power base Mao established, remains divided between loyalty to his myth and condemnation of his 'mistakes,' which led to the deaths of tens of millions of people.
